executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_employment_delivery_cause_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'旧文件不覆盖：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
result=readj(R+'/result.json');diag=readj(R+'/固定失败归因_信号费用与原叶.json')
assert not result['primary_increment_gate_passed'] and diag['signal']['actual_added_field_path_events']==3
events=pd.read_csv(ROOT/R/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv',usecols=['model','era','idx','signal_date','actual_added_path','path'])
selected=events[(events.model=='就业配送十变量')&(events.era=='2024—2025')&events.actual_added_path].copy();assert len(selected)==3
field='制造业从业人员原扩散指数'
assert all(field in p for p in selected.path)
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/R/'原八字段与就业配送两字段_未读标签.parquet',columns=['idx','date','decision_time','stat_month',field,'就业配送来源可知时间'])
assert (d.idx.to_numpy()==d.index.to_numpy()).all()
targets=[]
for e in selected.itertuples(index=False):
 z=d.loc[int(e.idx)]
 targets.append({'idx':int(e.idx),'signal_date':e.signal_date,'stat_month':z.stat_month,'employment_original_value':float(z[field]),'source_known_at':pd.Timestamp(z['就业配送来源可知时间']).isoformat(),'decision_at':pd.Timestamp(z.decision_time).isoformat(),'selection':'全部原实际就业路径，未按该机会收益选择'})
values=sorted({z['employment_original_value'] for z in targets})
members=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1/全部1711原当前成熟成员_原因来源与原决定钟.csv',usecols=['idx','stat_month'])
months=sorted(set(members.stat_month));assert len(months)==86 and len(members)==1711
source=readj(R+'/全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json')
same=[{'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'employment_original_value':z[field],'source_url':z['source_url'],'available_at':z['available_at'],'raw_path':z['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':z['raw_sha256'],'same_current_value_not_same_change_or_cause':True} for z in source if z['stat_month'] in months and z[field] in values]
save('E67原实际就业路径值_全86月同值母集_未读新收益.json',{'created_at':now(),'full_original_stat_month_population':months,'full_original_members_kept':1711,'full_original_score_days_kept':1212,'all_three_primary_actual_employment_paths':targets,'fixed_target_values':values,'all_original_matching_months':same,'equity_labels_or_prices_read_in_this_population_program':False,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'no_new_model_candidate':True})
paths=[R+'/result.json',R+'/固定失败归因_信号费用与原叶.json',R+'/E67原实际就业路径值_全86月同值母集_未读新收益.json']
proposal={'experiment_id':'E67','study_id':'510300_ORIGINAL_EMPLOYMENT_ADJUSTMENT_TARGETED_CAUSE_OBJECT_V1','proposed_at':now(),'status':'PROPOSED_ORIGINAL_EMPLOYMENT_ADJUSTMENT_CAUSE_OBJECT_CONTRACT_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN',
 'question':'固定全部原三条实际就业路径所用值及全86原月所有同值月份，是否有明确针对制造业从业人员变化的公开原因，而非把综合PMI春节/宏观理由移到就业？',
 'why_next':'E65三条新增高分实际路径只使用就业，没有配送；E66主期去费均仍负，费用/配送反号/单列删除不能营救。停止继续轮换PMI原值列找分数改善，先回答实际使用问项为什么调整。',
 'selection_disclosure':'以全部原实际路径识别被使用字段，不按赢家/输家选月；既有历史已见，属于对失败模型的有限机制解释，不是独立检验或新交易模型。',
 'fixed_target_values':values,'all_original_matching_months':same,'all_three_original_actual_paths':targets,
 'source_order':'实际登记后先核已存原官方解释及当次原HTML当前/上一月行；缺原解释仅按全部同值母集时间顺序限定最多4统计局官方原查询/4GET。旧原稿或不同目标不跳过；全母集与未取/未提及理由UNKNOWN保持，不把局部支持用于全原模型。',
 'semantic_contract':'解释对象必须明确制造业从业人员/用工变化；制造业整体PMI、生产、企业经营预期、疫情/节日背景分别保存，不能自动转移。原同值、月变、方法/季调/时钟、调查母体和来源对象分别记录。',
 'full_original_source_population_gate':'仅本有限同值原因发现；即使这些月有说明，也不准入全部1212模型，全部1711原因/当年首版支持仍未建。',
 'hard_stop':'真实原对象未定位、显示钟未知或就业直接理由未提及则UNKNOWN并结束限定路线；不换统计月/同义问项/搜索词/第三机构营救，不看收益造原因类别。',
 'network_budget_if_registered':{'official_queries_max':4,'official_original_GETs_max':4,'authenticated_requests':0,'retries':0},
 'model_budget':{'new_models':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grid':0},
 'planned_output':'全部同值原月问项/原行与来源对象矩阵、三条原就业路径的明确理由/共同理由/背景/UNKNOWN、原母集保留及终止条件。',
 'parents':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in paths],'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False}
save('next_experiment.json',proposal)
print(json.dumps({'下一E67':'仅来源与解释对象合同提案，未登记/未运行','全部原三就业路径':targets,'原全86同值月':same,'新金融标签/拟合/账户/源码/网络':0},ensure_ascii=False))
